# Work Packages: Screener UI Improvements

**Inputs**: Design documents from `/kitty-specs/002-screener-ui-improvements/`
**Prerequisites**: spec.md (user stories)

**Tests**: Not explicitly requested. Testing is optional but validation guidance is provided per WP.

**Organization**: Fine-grained subtasks (`Txxx`) roll up into work packages (`WPxx`). Each work package must be independently deliverable and testable.

**Prompt Files**: Each work package references a matching prompt file in `/tasks/` generated by `/spec-kitty.tasks`.

## Subtask Format: `[Txxx] [P?] Description`
- **[P]** indicates the subtask can proceed in parallel (different files/components).
- Paths reference `tools/investment-screener/` as project root.

## Path Conventions
- **Frontend**: `frontend/src/`
- **Backend**: `backend/src/`, `backend/py_services/`

---

## Work Package WP01: Fix Yahoo API Data & Backend Bridge (Priority: P0)

**Goal**: Fix the broken yfinance data integration so all Yahoo reference values (Growth Rate, Net Margin, Forward P/E, Share Change) populate correctly on the Valuation Modeler sliders. This is the foundation — other UI work depends on real data flowing.
**Independent Test**: Search for AAPL/NVDA/INTC — all sliders should show actual Yahoo values instead of "N/A%". "Reset to Yahoo" button should work.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP01-fix-yahoo-api-data.md`
**Estimated Size**: ~400 lines, 6 subtasks

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T001 Debug `fetch_financials.py` to identify why `revenue_growth`, `profit_margin`, `forward_pe` return None/N/A for major tickers
- [x] T002 Fix yfinance field extraction — map correct `stock.info` keys to the expected output fields (revenue_growth, profit_margin, forward_pe, share change)
- [x] T003 Add analyst revenue/earnings forecast data extraction (high/low/avg estimates for current + next year) to `fetch_financials.py` output
- [x] T004 Update `backend/src/index.ts` response handling to pass through new forecast fields
- [x] T005 [P] Update `frontend/src/services/api.ts` StockData interface to include new forecast fields (analyst revenue estimates, earnings estimates)
- [x] T006 [P] Update `ValuationModeler.tsx` to correctly read and display Yahoo reference values below each slider; fix "Reset to Yahoo" button

### Implementation Notes
- Start by running `python3 fetch_financials.py AAPL` locally and inspecting the raw output to identify which fields are missing.
- yfinance `stock.info` keys have changed over library versions — verify correct key names (e.g., `revenueGrowth` vs `revenue_growth`).
- Analyst estimates may live in `stock.analyst_price_targets`, `stock.earnings_estimate`, or `stock.revenue_estimate`.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T005 and T006 (frontend updates) can proceed in parallel once T001-T004 backend fixes are confirmed.

### Dependencies
- None (starting package — all other WPs benefit from working data).

### Risks & Mitigations
- yfinance API may have changed field names → inspect `stock.info.keys()` at runtime.
- Some tickers may genuinely lack analyst estimates → display "N/A" with tooltip.

---

## Work Package WP02: Multi-Mode Analysis Chart (Priority: P1) 🎯 MVP

**Goal**: Replace the fixed Analysis tab layout with a single chart area that has toggle buttons to switch between Revenue & Earnings, Free Cash Flow, Margins, and EPS Growth views.
**Independent Test**: Analysis tab shows toggle buttons; clicking each button renders the correct chart with data from the backend.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP02-multi-mode-analysis-chart.md`
**Estimated Size**: ~450 lines, 6 subtasks

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T007 Extend `fetch_financials.py` to return additional historical data: FCF, gross/operating/net margins, EPS (5-year arrays)
- [x] T008 Update `api.ts` StockData interface with new financial arrays (historical_fcf, historical_margins, historical_eps)
- [x] T009 Create `AnalysisChartToggle.tsx` component — button group for switching chart modes (Revenue & Earnings | FCF | Margins | EPS Growth)
- [x] T010 Refactor `FundamentalChart.tsx` into a generic `FinancialChart.tsx` that accepts different data series based on active mode
- [x] T011 [P] Build Margins chart variant (3 area lines: gross, operating, net margin %)
- [x] T012 Update `Dashboard.tsx` Analysis tab to use new AnalysisChartToggle + FinancialChart instead of old fixed layout

### Implementation Notes
- Chart toggle state lives in the Analysis tab (Dashboard.tsx) — no new API calls when switching modes.
- All financial data fetched in single `/api/stock/:ticker` call; chart just renders different slices.
- Reuse Recharts AreaChart/ComposedChart patterns from existing FundamentalChart.tsx.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T011 (Margins variant) can be built independently from T010 (generic chart refactor).

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (needs backend returning full financial data).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Some tickers may lack FCF or margin history → show "Insufficient data" message for that chart mode.

## Work Package WP03: Analyst Forecast Overlay (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Extend the Revenue & Earnings chart with dotted forecast lines showing analyst high/low/average estimates for 2026-2027.
**Independent Test**: On the Revenue & Earnings chart, dotted lines extend beyond historical data showing 2026 and 2027 forecasts with clear visual distinction.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP03-analyst-forecast-overlay.md`
**Estimated Size**: ~350 lines, 5 subtasks

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T013 Ensure `fetch_financials.py` returns structured analyst revenue estimates: `{ year: 2026, high, low, avg }` and `{ year: 2027, high, low, avg }`
- [x] T014 Update `api.ts` StockData interface with `analyst_revenue_forecast` array
- [x] T015 Extend `FinancialChart.tsx` (Revenue & Earnings mode) to render forecast region — dashed lines for high/low/avg, shaded forecast zone
- [x] T016 Add forecast region annotation (label "Forecast" or shaded background to distinguish from historical)
- [x] T017 Handle missing forecast data gracefully — if no analyst estimates, show historical only with no forecast section

### Implementation Notes
- Forecast lines should use Recharts `Line` with `strokeDasharray="5 5"` for dotted appearance.
- Use a `ReferenceArea` for the shaded forecast zone.
- Forecast data appended to the same data array but flagged with `isForecast: true`.

### Parallel Opportunities
- All subtasks are sequential (build on each other).

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (analyst data from backend) and WP02 (FinancialChart.tsx refactor).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Yahoo may not have revenue forecasts for all tickers → graceful degradation.

## Work Package WP04: Rule of 40 Separate Tab (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Move Rule of 40 out of the Analysis tab into its own dedicated top-nav tab.
**Independent Test**: Navigation shows 4 tabs: Overview | Analysis | Rule of 40 | Valuation. Rule of 40 tab renders the chart with contextual info. Analysis tab no longer shows Rule of 40.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP04-rule-of-40-tab.md`
**Estimated Size**: ~300 lines, 5 subtasks

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T018 Create `RuleOf40Page.tsx` component — dedicated view with the Rule of 40 chart, score display, and educational context (what it means, SaaS/Tech warning)
- [x] T019 Update `Dashboard.tsx` tab navigation to add "Rule of 40" as 4th tab between Analysis and Valuation
- [x] T020 Remove RuleOf40Chart from the Analysis tab layout (Analysis now only shows financial charts from WP02)
- [x] T021 Add contextual content to RuleOf40Page: explanation text, score interpretation, sector applicability warning
- [x] T022 [P] Style the Rule of 40 page consistent with Luxury Dark theme — card layout, amber/green color coding

### Implementation Notes
- The existing `RuleOf40Chart.tsx` component can be reused as-is inside the new page.
- Tab type in Dashboard.tsx changes from `'overview' | 'analysis' | 'valuation'` to include `'ruleof40'`.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T022 (styling) can proceed independently.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP02 (Analysis tab refactor — ensures no conflicts when removing Rule of 40 from Analysis).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Tab navigation may get crowded — ensure responsive design handles 4 tabs gracefully.

## Work Package WP05: Valuation Layout Redesign (Priority: P1)

**Goal**: Redesign the Valuation Modeler for better screen real estate usage — side-by-side inputs and results, compact sliders, minimal scrolling on 1080p.
**Independent Test**: On a 1080p display, the full Valuation Modeler (sliders + scenario results) is visible without scrolling.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP05-valuation-layout-redesign.md`
**Estimated Size**: ~450 lines, 6 subtasks

### Included Subtasks
- [x] T023 Redesign ValuationModeler layout: left panel (sliders) + right panel (scenario results, expert analysis)
- [x] T024 Compact the slider inputs — tighter vertical spacing, 3 sliders per row where possible, smaller input boxes
- [x] T025 Redesign Bear/Base/Bull scenario cards as a compact horizontal row or table format
- [x] T026 Move the "Expert Analysis Summary" (Strong Value / Potential Value / etc.) into the right panel alongside scenario results
- [x] T027 Add a mini scenario comparison chart (optional visual) — bar chart showing bear/base/bull targets vs current price
- [x] T028 Ensure responsive behavior — graceful stacking on smaller screens

### Implementation Notes
- This is a major layout refactor of ValuationModeler.tsx (374 lines).
- Use Tailwind grid: `grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2` for responsive side-by-side.
- Sliders can use `grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3` for compact arrangement.
- Keep the calculation logic untouched — this is purely a layout/UI change.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T027 (mini chart) can be built independently as an additive component.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP01 (Yahoo data fix — layout should show real data, not N/A).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Sliders too compact may hurt usability on touch devices → test slider thumb size.
- 3-column slider layout may not work well on 1080p — fallback to 2-column.

## Work Package WP06: Saved Projections Management (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Add a "My Projections" button that opens a panel/modal to view, edit, delete, and load previously saved projections and notes.
**Independent Test**: Save a projection for AAPL → click "My Projections" → see saved entry with date, values, notes → click "Load" → sliders update.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP06-saved-projections.md`
**Estimated Size**: ~400 lines, 6 subtasks

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T029 Create `ProjectionsPanel.tsx` component — modal/slide-out panel listing saved projections for current ticker
- [ ] T030 Display projection entries: date saved, scenario values summary (growth, margin, PE), notes preview
- [ ] T031 Implement "Load" action — populate sliders with saved scenario values
- [ ] T032 Implement "Edit" action — open notes in edit mode, allow updating scenario values
- [ ] T033 Implement "Delete" action with confirmation dialog
- [ ] T034 Add "My Projections" button to ValuationModeler header, show count badge if projections exist

### Implementation Notes
- LocalStorage key pattern: `projection_{SYMBOL}` — currently stores single projection per ticker.
- Consider changing to array storage: `projections_{SYMBOL}` → `[{ id, scenarios, notes, savedAt }, ...]` to support multiple projections per ticker.
- Migration: On first load, if old format exists, migrate to new array format.

### Parallel Opportunities
- T029 (panel component) and T034 (button) can be built in parallel.

### Dependencies
- Depends on WP05 (Valuation layout redesign — button placement needs final layout).

### Risks & Mitigations
- LocalStorage size limits (~5MB) unlikely to be hit, but warn if > 50 projections total.

## Work Package WP07: Dashboard, Settings & App Branding (Priority: P2)

**Goal**: Wire up the Dashboard and Settings sidebar links with functional views. Rename the app from "Spec Kitty / Investment Screener" to a proper product name.
**Independent Test**: Clicking Dashboard/Settings sidebar links navigates to functional pages. App header/sidebar shows new branding.
**Prompt**: `/tasks/WP07-dashboard-settings-branding.md`
**Estimated Size**: ~400 lines, 7 subtasks

### Included Subtasks
- [ ] T035 Rename app branding — replace "Spec Kitty / Investment Screener" in Sidebar.tsx header with new name (e.g., "Market Intelligence" or similar from the existing header text). Remove the Spec Kitty branding.
- [ ] T036 Create `DashboardHome.tsx` — landing page showing recently analyzed tickers with quick stats (last price, % change), quick-launch links
- [ ] T037 Wire Sidebar "Dashboard" link to navigate to DashboardHome view
- [ ] T038 Create `SettingsPage.tsx` — settings page with: data cache settings, clear saved data option, about/version info
- [ ] T039 Wire Sidebar "Settings" link to navigate to SettingsPage
- [ ] T040 Update `App.tsx` routing to include new routes (`/dashboard`, `/settings`)
- [ ] T041 [P] Update Sidebar.tsx to highlight active nav item based on current route

### Implementation Notes
- The app already has "Market Intelligence" as the top header text — use this as the primary branding.
- DashboardHome can reuse `useRecentTickers()` hook for recent history.
- Settings page is minimal for now — theme toggle and cache clearing.
- Consider making "/" route show DashboardHome, and stock analysis moves to "/analyze?ticker=NVDA".

### Parallel Opportunities
- T036 (Dashboard) and T038 (Settings) can be built in parallel.
- T041 (active nav) is independent.

### Dependencies
- None (independent package).

### Risks & Mitigations
- Routing changes may break existing bookmarks (e.g., `/?ticker=NVDA`) → ensure backward compatibility or redirects.

## Dependency & Execution Summary

- **Sequence**: WP01 → WP02 → WP03 (forecast depends on chart refactor) → WP04 (Rule of 40 tab)
- **Parallel after WP01**: WP05 (valuation layout) can proceed in parallel with WP02-WP04
- **Later packages**: WP06 depends on WP05. WP07 has no dependencies and can start anytime.
- **MVP Scope**: WP01 + WP02 + WP05 (fix data, add chart modes, compact valuation)

```
WP01 (Yahoo Fix) ──→ WP02 (Multi-Chart) ──→ WP03 (Forecast Overlay)
       │                      │
       │                      └──→ WP04 (Rule of 40 Tab)
       │
       └──→ WP05 (Valuation Layout) ──→ WP06 (Projections)

WP07 (Dashboard/Settings/Branding) ── independent, do anytime
```
